title: Van Reede to William V, Berlin 4 Feb 1792 (DECODE R1057)

documents.shelfmark: KHA The Hague, Prins Willem V, inv.nr. 205

transcription.notes: 4204 corrected to 4202 (tro) from the image and gloss.

system.summary: The 1782 one-part French Grand Chiffre of William V (DECODE key R1024, 1-5000), with a declared tail of null groups.
system.sibling_key: DECODE R1024, already used to read vanreede1787 (R1026/R1027).
system.notes: The plaintext itself declares the final 21 groups non-valeurs.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary interlinear gloss over the first eight lines, transcribed garbled on DECODE; the null tail was never glossed.

conditions.human_role: The human supplied the target and the DECODE cookie.

solution.what: Record, transcription and image already downloaded in the vanreede1787 session.
Decoded all groups with key R1024 (Grand Chiffre).
Checked groups against the image and interlinear gloss; corrected 4204 to 4202.
Read: lemon-juice invisible ink on the enclosure's blank half-pages, for Larrey to pass to the Prince; last 21 groups declared nulls.

outcome.method_basis: The letter was decoded straight through with William V's 1782 Grand Chiffre (DECODE R1024), the key already used for Van Reede's letters to the Prince (vanreede1787), and checked against the contemporary interlinear gloss over the first eight lines.
outcome.notes: All 62 message groups read; the 21 remaining groups are nulls by the letter's own statement. The enclosure in invisible ink is not on the record.
